module_summary: Reservoir flow-valve controller: a 6-state Moore FSM tracks water level and rise/fall direction from sensors and decodes a 4-bit valve vector per state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Encodes water level band and whether it last rose or fell; selects valve outputs.

anchors.name: fr
anchors.why: State-decoded valve vector driving fr2, fr1, fr0 and dfr outputs.

groups.name: level_fsm
groups.description: Level/direction FSM advanced by the three level sensors.

groups.name: valve_decoder
groups.description: Maps each state to flow-rate valve outputs.
